summary: Defines two SDP attributes, group and mid, which group several media lines in a session description for purposes such as lip synchronization or receiving one flow in several formats on different ports. It was replaced by RFC 5888.

eli5.summary: A video call has a sound track and a picture track. This tags them so they can be grouped and played in step with each other.
